persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your full legal name as it appears on your legal documents?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Um—sorry, do you mean the name on my ID? I always get this bit mixed up. It’s Ethan, and the last name is Park, I think… or, well, that’s how I usually say it.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: How would you like your gender recorded?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Male.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your date of birth? You may use DD/MM/YYYY or a written date.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Oh—date of birth. Right. I’m blanking on the exact format you want, and I keep mixing up whether you want the day first or the month first. I know it’s on my documents somewhere, but I’m not really sure I’m supposed to give it in that format here… could you say it again?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your full home address, including street address, city, and province?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s 20 Charles Street West… and Toronto, Ontario. I’m not sure if you wanted the postal code too, but that’s the part I remember best.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your Canadian postal code?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Sorry, postal code… do you mean the long sort of code at the end of the address? I always mix that up. I know it’s there, I just can’t pull it out right now. Could you ask it again, maybe with the exact format?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat the postal code using letters and numbers.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: M4Y1R6

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your email address?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: ethan.park@example.com

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your phone number, including area code?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Uh, the phone number… I can never remember whether you want it as digits or spoken out, and I tend to jumble the first part. It starts with four one six, and then the rest is on my phone somewhere, I think. Could you ask for it another way?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please repeat your 10-digit phone number.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a family doctor?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, I do.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your family doctor's full first and last name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Dr. Grace Lim.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a psychiatrist?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s mostly this… I get really stuck when I have to speak in meetings or if there’s a group thing at work, and then I sort of go red and shake, which is embarrassing, and I start avoiding the socials too. I even turned down a promotion because it meant presenting, so that was… not great.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I want to be able to speak up in a meeting without panicking, basically. And, um, I’d like to take the next promotion if it comes up instead of dodging it.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please describe your early childhood, including where you were born or grew up and what you were like as a young child.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I was born and raised in Toronto, and as a kid I was pretty quiet, sort of watchful, I guess. I didn’t really put myself forward much.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
